concerns.text: FR-009 (log all data-inclusion/exclusion decisions) and SC-001 (report p-value) are not fully covered. T020 (standardized logging invocation) is marked [X] but the Analyze Report flags it as 'REJECTED' and missing. T018/T019 depend on T020, creating a circular dependency where the logging mechanism required for FR-009 is effectively absent. Without a valid T020, the exclusion logging required by FR-009 cannot be implemented.

FR-006 (10,000 permutation tests) and SC-001 (report p-value) are missing tasks. The Analyze Report explicitly states T027 (run_permutation_test) is 'REJECTED' and missing code. No other task in Phase 3 or 5 implements the permutation logic or generates the empirical p-value required by FR-006 and SC-001.

FR-008 (generate diagnostic visualisations) and SC-004 (save plots < 5MB) are missing tasks. The Analyze Report flags T022 and T023 (scatter and residual plots) as 'REJECTED' with missing source code. No tasks exist to implement the visualization functions or save the required PNG files.

FR-010 (sensitivity analysis) and SC-002/SC-005 (sensitivity table) are missing tasks. The Analyze Report states T046 (run_sensitivity_analysis) is 'REJECTED' and missing code. Consequently, T030 (save sensitivity summary) cannot be fulfilled, leaving the sensitivity analysis requirement unimplemented.

FR-005 (fit OLS regression) and SC-003 (report ΔR²) are partially blocked. While T051 implements the regression, T017 and T017.1 (reporting Pearson r and ΔR²) are marked 'REJECTED' in the Analyze Report. The tasks to format and save the regression results (specifically the ΔR² to 4 decimal places) are effectively missing or non-functional.

Stale or contradictory task status: T020 is marked [X] (completed) in the task list, but the Analyze Report explicitly flags it as 'REJECTED' and missing. This discrepancy prevents the implementer from knowing whether the standardized logging is actually available or if the task needs to be re-written.

Stale or contradictory task status: T022 and T023 are marked [X] (completed) in the task list, but the Analyze Report flags them as 'REJECTED' with missing source code. This creates a false impression of coverage for FR-008.

Stale or contradictory task status: T027 and T046 are marked [X] (completed) in the task list, but the Analyze Report flags them as 'REJECTED' with missing code. This creates a false impression of coverage for FR-006 and FR-010.
